start: Signed in on a phone, dark screen

steps.action: Tap the round button at the top right ('Screen and language')
user_sees: A small menu with Dark | Light and English | Hinglish
must_not: The menu wider than the screen

steps.action: Tap Light
user_sees: Every part of the page turns light at once; Light is marked as chosen
must_not: A part of the page left dark
A reload

steps.action: Close and open the admin app
user_sees: Still light
must_not: Back to dark

start: The 'Screen and language' menu (on a computer: the switches at the top right)

steps.action: Tap 'Hinglish'
user_sees: Menu, buttons and page words change to Hinglish at once; 'Hinglish' is marked
must_not: English and Hinglish mixed on one screen
A member's name or a saved note changed

steps.action: Tap outside the menu or press Escape
user_sees: The menu closes
must_not: The menu stuck open over the page

start: Settings, card 'Put the admin app on your phone'

steps.action: Read the card
user_sees: 'It sits on your home screen and opens full screen, in one tap.' and a button 'Install the admin app' (or 'Show me how')
must_not: The card shown when the app is already installed

steps.action: Tap 'Install the admin app' and accept
user_sees: 'The admin app is on your home screen. Open it from the MettleUp Admin icon.'
must_not: The card still asking to install
A second icon on the home screen

start: A private window that blocks storage; a browser that cannot install

steps.action: Pick Light and Hinglish
user_sees: Both apply for this visit
must_not: A crash
An error box about storage

steps.action: Open Settings, the install card, on an iPhone
user_sees: Numbered steps (Share, then Add to Home Screen) and no install button that does nothing
must_not: A button that looks live and does nothing

start: Signed in, Light and Hinglish chosen; the install banner showing on a phone

steps.action: Switch back to Dark and English
user_sees: Both back, at once
must_not: One screen left in the old choice

steps.action: Close the install banner
user_sees: It is gone and stays gone after a reload
must_not: The banner back on every visit

steps.action: Sign out and sign in as another person on the same device
user_sees: The same screen and language choice (it belongs to the device)
must_not: The choice reset by signing out
